checks.desc: all CSVs load into the constrained schema.sql (PK/FK/CHECK enforced)
order delivered before it was placed
delivery_date presence must match order status
return requested before delivery, or for an undelivered order, or after snapshot
line decision date before request, or PENDING/decided_at mismatch
authorization before request or expiry != decided_at + 21 days
shipment dates out of order (label <= shipped <= received)
refund paid before an inspection of its request
non-restock movement posted before the inspection
state event after the snapshot date
order line arithmetic (gross, net, paid, tax)
order header totals must equal sum of lines (and have lines)
refund_line refund != paid_share - restocking fee - condition deduction (entity = refund)
refund header (attempt 1) != sum of lines - return shipping fee
paid_cents must equal amount for ISSUED and 0 for BLOCKED_DUPLICATE; replays carry no lines
fully returned order line: refunded gross/discount/tax must equal the order line (discount and tax reconciliation)
refund_line order_line must match its return_line; return request customer must match order customer
quantity chain: expected <= approved, shipped <= expected, received <= shipped, inspected = received, disposition qty = inspected
approved return quantity exceeds purchased quantity
refund exceeds paid share of a line, or cumulative refunds exceed the amount paid for the order line
sellable restock posted before the inspection of that line
approved after the policy window (version in force at delivery) with no override
second ISSUED payout for the same idempotency key
override approvals must satisfy the goodwill rule (GOLD <= 21 days late, SILVER <= 10) and carry a code
approved quantity in a final-sale category, or opened beauty without seller fault
decision fields inconsistent (REJECTED needs qty 0; APPROVED needs qty>=1 and reason; authorization iff approved line)
disposition must follow grade (A restock, B refurbish, C refurbish if cost>=1500 else scrap, D scrap, W/S quarantine); location follows disposition
inventory movement must be controlled by its disposition (type, location, qty, sellable delta)
refund only after inspection, only for eligible lines, never for exchange requests
return shipping fee rule (799 flat, waived for GOLD or any seller-fault line, capped at merchandise total)
state transition not allowed by the lifecycle
from_state must equal the previous to_state of the same entity (history is continuous and ordered)
current status column must equal the last event
event points to a missing parent, or an entity has no initial event
lifecycle vs facts: AUTHORIZED+ needs an authorization; RECEIVED+ needs received parcels; INSPECTED+ needs inspections; REFUNDED needs an ISSUED refund
one return request per (order line, request) and one authorization / inspection per owner
policy versions of one category must not overlap
